title: I PORTATORI DEI VELLUTI RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: I PORTATORI DEI VELLUTI RERUN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: I Portatori dei Velluti event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Quadriglia] & [Splendida Cavalcata] & [Decadanza]
[Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete Daily Commissions in [Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio] by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: Carnival Canister (provides random materials)
[Programma della Parata]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Programma della Parata] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★★: Crownslayer], Old Siracusan Tailor Shop (Pieces), Module Materials, Invito Mistico, etc.
[Fiera delle Meraviglie Notturne]

DETAILS: During the event, you can collect [Invito Mistico] by participating in the event and use them to redeem items for rewards. REWARDS: Crownslayer's Token, Old Siracusan Tailor Shop (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, and more.
Note:

- For this rerun event, some of the engraved medals in the corresponding Engraved Medal Set will have their acquisition conditions adjusted. Players who meet the updated conditions will be able to obtain the event's engraved medals. Due to these adjustments, players who previously participated in the event and already meet the new acquisition conditions will receive the corresponding engraved medals immediately upon the update.
- After this rerun event ends, the engraved medals from the event's Engraved Medal Set cannot be obtained again through [Score] or any other channels.
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Lappland the Decadenza, Vulpisfoglia, Crownslayer, and Figurino will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
- After this event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to [Score] on May 21, 2026, at 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Iteration Provident Series - The Dark Night Terminator for Crownslayer
03 0011 TEMPEST SERIES RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
0011 Tempest Series - Ignis Fatuus for Lessing
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – CRAZY CARNIVAL CABIN & OLD SIRACUSAN TAILOR SHOP
DETAILS: Furniture sets, Crazy Carnival Cabin and Old Siracusan Tailor Shop will be available again during the event.
Crazy Carnival Cabin
HOW TO OBTAIN: Limited-time sale at the Store
Old Siracusan Tailor Shop
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- I Portatori dei Velluti event rewards (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
05 SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can claim special rewards, including: Orundum, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, LMD, etc. These rewards will be sent via in-game mail.
NOTE:
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
06 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Light and Shadow Commemorative Pack
CONTENTS: Orundum * 800, Icon 'This you?' * 1, Icon 'Chongyue Chronicles' * 1, Icon 'Cut!' * 1
Photographic Remnant Pack
CONTENTS: Profile Theme 'Highlights' * 1
The profile theme can be viewed and used in Profile.
07 RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
CROSSOVER Collection - All-Round Actor for Chongyue
CROSSOVER Collection - Thunderbolt Director for Nian
CROSSOVER Collection - 'Ride to Davistown' for Jessica the Liberated
NOTE:
- [Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the above outfits.
Please stay tuned for more information!
